name: four-policy-feature-study-v1
duplicate_policy: Retain annotations and supplied contexts; group normalized bodies across familiar-policy folds, purge every training body/support matching a validation body. Report inverse-body-policy-frequency weighted metrics and conflicting-label exclusion sensitivity.
confirmation_promotion: No automatic promotion. Freeze a candidate/reference only after development evidence, feature-family ablations and failure analysis. The protected reserve cannot be used to revise feature selection.
stopping_rule: This milestone tests transfer of the prior feature search to four development policies. Diminishing returns require agreement of major-family additions/removals, screening/full-space and low-rank controls, per-policy results, robustness and cost. A plausible untested family or material instability keeps the feature gate open. No final retraining in this study.
